entries.name: Context
entries.summary: Context carries one request through a Handler: read the request with its accessors, then answer with one of its response methods.

entries.name: Context.App
entries.summary: App returns the application serving this request.

entries.name: Context.CSRFToken
entries.summary: CSRFToken returns the request's CSRF token for forms and htmx headers that post back, or "" outside Middleware.CSRF.

entries.name: Context.Cookie
entries.summary: Cookie returns a request cookie's value, or "" when it is not set.

entries.name: Context.Ctx
entries.summary: Ctx returns the request's context.Context, for cancellation and deadlines.

entries.name: Context.FormValue
entries.summary: FormValue returns a submitted form field, parsing the body on first use.

entries.name: Context.Header
entries.summary: Header returns a request header.

entries.name: Context.IsHTMX
entries.summary: IsHTMX reports whether htmx sent the request.

entries.name: Context.Method
entries.summary: Method returns the request method.

entries.name: Context.Param
entries.summary: Param returns a route parameter, such as {id} in "/users/{id}".

entries.name: Context.ParamInt
entries.summary: ParamInt returns a route parameter as an int.

entries.name: Context.Path
entries.summary: Path returns the request URL path.

entries.name: Context.Queries
entries.summary: Queries returns every value of a query parameter.

entries.name: Context.Query
entries.summary: Query returns the first value of a query string parameter.

entries.name: Context.QueryDefault
entries.summary: QueryDefault returns the first query value, or fallback when it is absent or empty.

entries.name: Context.QueryInt
entries.signature: func (c *Context) QueryInt(key string, fallback int) int
entries.summary: QueryInt returns a query parameter as an int, or fallback when it is absent or not an integer.

entries.name: Context.Request
entries.summary: Request returns the underlying *http.Request.

entries.name: Context.Response
entries.summary: Response returns the underlying http.ResponseWriter, for code that has to write the response itself (streaming, a third-party encoder).

entries.name: Context.Session
entries.summary: Session returns the request's session, or nil when the route does not run behind SessionMiddleware (see UseSessions).

entries.name: Context.UserID
entries.summary: UserID returns the authenticated user's ID set by the auth middleware, or "" for an anonymous request.

entries.name: Context.Value
entries.summary: Value returns a value attached to the request with WithContext, typically by middleware.

entries.name: HyperChi.NewContext
entries.summary: NewContext builds a Context outside a route, for tests and for adapters that receive a plain net/http request.

entries.name: Context.Blob
entries.summary: Blob writes body with the given content type, for responses Text and HTML do not cover (Markdown, CSV, images).

entries.name: Context.Empty
entries.summary: Empty sends the status (200 unless set with Status) and headers with no body, for responses whose headers are the answer.

entries.name: Context.Fragment
entries.signature: func (c *Context) Fragment(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: Fragment renders a template without a layout, for htmx swaps.

entries.name: Context.HTML
entries.summary: HTML writes trusted HTML.

entries.name: Context.HX
entries.summary: HX returns the htmx helper for this request.

entries.name: Context.JSON
entries.summary: JSON writes data as a JSON response.

entries.name: Context.Layout
entries.summary: Layout picks the layout template ("layout-<name>") for Page and View.

entries.name: Context.NoContent
entries.summary: NoContent sends 204 No Content.

entries.name: Context.Page
entries.signature: func (c *Context) Page(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: Page renders a template inside its layout, whatever sent the request.

entries.name: Context.Redirect
entries.summary: Redirect sends the client to url.

entries.name: Context.RenderWith
entries.signature: func (c *Context) RenderWith(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: RenderWith renders through a named integration (see Integrations), such as a templ or Jet adapter, buffering before any header is sent.

entries.name: Context.SetCookie
entries.summary: SetCookie adds a Set-Cookie header to the response.

entries.name: Context.SetHeader
entries.summary: SetHeader sets a response header.

entries.name: Context.Status
entries.summary: Status sets the status code for the response this handler sends next.

entries.name: Context.Text
entries.summary: Text writes a plain-text response.

entries.name: Context.View
entries.signature: func (c *Context) View(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: View renders a template the way the request needs it: the full page inside its layout for a normal or boosted navigation, and the template alone for an htmx partial request.

entries.name: HX
entries.summary: HX reads htmx request headers and sets htmx response headers.

entries.name: HX.Boosted
entries.summary: Boosted reports a boosted link or form navigation (HX-Boosted).

entries.name: HX.CurrentURL
entries.summary: CurrentURL is the page the browser was on (HX-Current-URL).

entries.name: HX.Empty
entries.summary: Empty finishes with an empty 200 response, for a request that only needs the htmx headers (a trigger, a refresh, a location change).

entries.name: HX.Fragment
entries.signature: func (h *HX) Fragment(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: Fragment finishes with Context.Fragment.

entries.name: HX.HTML
entries.summary: HTML finishes with Context.HTML.

entries.name: HX.JSON
entries.summary: JSON finishes with Context.JSON.

entries.name: HX.Location
entries.summary: Location navigates without a full reload (HX-Location).

entries.name: HX.NoContent
entries.summary: NoContent finishes with Context.NoContent, which still sends the headers.

entries.name: HX.Page
entries.signature: func (h *HX) Page(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: Page finishes with Context.Page.

entries.name: HX.PushURL
entries.summary: PushURL pushes url onto browser history (HX-Push-Url).

entries.name: HX.Refresh
entries.summary: Refresh makes the browser reload the page (HX-Refresh).

entries.name: HX.ReplaceURL
entries.summary: ReplaceURL replaces the current history entry (HX-Replace-Url).

entries.name: HX.Reselect
entries.summary: Reselect picks part of the response to swap (HX-Reselect).

entries.name: HX.Reswap
entries.summary: Reswap changes the swap strategy, such as "outerHTML" (HX-Reswap).

entries.name: HX.Retarget
entries.summary: Retarget swaps the response into a different element (HX-Retarget).

entries.name: HX.Source
entries.summary: Source is the element that issued the request, as "tag#id" (HX-Source).

entries.name: HX.Status
entries.summary: Status sets the response status, as Context.Status does.

entries.name: HX.Target
entries.summary: Target identifies the element htmx will swap into, as "tagName#id" such as "div#results" (HX-Target).

entries.name: HX.Trigger
entries.summary: Trigger fires a client-side event after the swap.

entries.name: HX.View
entries.signature: func (h *HX) View(name string, data any) error
entries.summary: View finishes with Context.View.

entries.name: HyperChi.SetGlobal
entries.summary: SetGlobal makes a value available to every template rendered through a Context, such as a site name or the Vite dev-server URL.

entries.name: Bind
entries.summary: Bind decodes the request into a new T and validates it.

entries.name: Context.Bind
entries.summary: Bind decodes and validates the request into dst, a pointer to a struct.

entries.name: Context.ValidateSchema
entries.summary: ValidateSchema checks the submitted form or JSON body against a schema registered on app.Schemas, returning the cleaned data, or a 422 error with per-field messages.

entries.name: BadRequest
entries.summary: BadRequest answers 400.

entries.name: Conflict
entries.summary: Conflict answers 409.

entries.name: ErrorFunc
entries.summary: ErrorFunc renders an error a Handler returned.

entries.name: Errorf
entries.signature: func Errorf(code int, format string, args ...any) *HTTPError
entries.summary: Errorf returns an HTTPError with a formatted message.

entries.name: FieldErrors
entries.summary: FieldErrors returns the per-field messages of a validation error from Bind or BindMessage, or nil for any other error.

entries.name: Forbidden
entries.summary: Forbidden answers 403.

entries.name: HTTPError
entries.summary: HTTPError is an error with an HTTP status.

entries.name: HTTPError.Error
entries.summary: Error reports the status code, message, and wrapped cause.

entries.name: HTTPError.Unwrap
entries.summary: Unwrap returns the wrapped cause, for errors.Is and errors.As.

entries.name: HTTPError.Wrap
entries.summary: Wrap attaches the underlying cause for logging.

entries.name: HyperChi.DefaultError
entries.summary: DefaultError renders err for the client that asked:

entries.name: HyperChi.OnError
entries.summary: OnError replaces the default error handler.

entries.name: HyperChi.RespondStatus
entries.signature: func (g *HyperChi) RespondStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, code int, err error)
entries.summary: RespondStatus answers a refusal from net/http middleware (a rate limiter, an auth check, an optional module) through the app's error pipeline, so it renders like every framework denial: OnError or DefaultError, with no-store headers.

entries.name: JSONErrors
entries.summary: JSONErrors makes the routes it wraps answer every error as JSON, whatever the request's Accept header says, for API routes whose clients never ask for HTML.

entries.name: NewHTTPError
entries.summary: NewHTTPError returns an error that answers with code and message.

entries.name: NotFound
entries.summary: NotFound answers 404.

entries.name: Unauthorized
entries.summary: Unauthorized answers 401.

entries.name: Unprocessable
entries.summary: Unprocessable answers 422 with per-field messages, the shape Bind returns when validation fails.

entries.name: CamelCase
entries.summary: CamelCase converts s to camelCase: "hello world" and "hello_world" become "helloWorld".

entries.name: Dedent
entries.summary: Dedent removes the leading whitespace that every non-blank line shares.

entries.name: Indent
entries.signature: func Indent(s string, indent string) string
entries.summary: Indent prefixes each non-blank line of s with indent.

entries.name: Join
entries.summary: Join joins parts with sep.

entries.name: JoinLines
entries.summary: JoinLines joins lines with "\n".

entries.name: JoinSpaces
entries.summary: JoinSpaces joins parts with single spaces.

entries.name: KebabCase
entries.summary: KebabCase converts s to kebab-case, splitting words as CamelCase does.

entries.name: PascalCase
entries.summary: PascalCase converts s to PascalCase, splitting words as CamelCase does.

entries.name: RandomString
entries.summary: RandomString returns length random characters from a-z, A-Z, and 0-9.

entries.name: S
entries.summary: S converts s to a Str.

entries.name: Slugify
entries.summary: Slugify creates a URL-friendly slug of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens: "Crème Brûlée à la carte" becomes "creme-brulee-a-la-carte".

entries.name: SnakeCase
entries.summary: SnakeCase converts s to snake_case, splitting words as CamelCase does: "userID" becomes "user_id" and "HTTPServer" becomes "http_server".

entries.name: Str
entries.summary: Str is a string with chainable methods: S(" Hi ").Trim().Lower().

entries.name: Str.Capitalize
entries.summary: Capitalize uppercases the first rune and leaves the rest unchanged.

entries.name: Str.Center
entries.signature: func (s Str) Center(width int, fill ...string) Str
entries.summary: Center centers the string in a field width runes wide.

entries.name: Str.CollapseWhitespace
entries.summary: CollapseWhitespace trims s and replaces each run of whitespace with one space.

entries.name: Str.Contains
entries.summary: Contains reports whether substr is in s.

entries.name: Str.ContainsAny
entries.summary: ContainsAny reports whether any rune in chars is in s.

entries.name: Str.Count
entries.summary: Count returns the number of non-overlapping occurrences of substr.

entries.name: Str.EndsWith
entries.summary: EndsWith reports whether s ends with suffix.

entries.name: Str.FindAll
entries.summary: FindAll returns every match of pattern, or the compile error for an invalid pattern.

entries.name: Str.Index
entries.summary: Index returns the rune offset of the first occurrence of substr, or -1.

entries.name: Str.IsAlpha
entries.summary: IsAlpha reports whether s is non-empty and every rune is a letter.

entries.name: Str.IsAlphaNumeric
entries.summary: IsAlphaNumeric reports whether s is non-empty and every rune is a letter or digit.

entries.name: Str.IsBlank
entries.summary: IsBlank reports whether s is empty or only whitespace.

entries.name: Str.IsDigits
entries.summary: IsDigits reports whether s is non-empty and every rune is a Unicode digit.

entries.name: Str.IsEmpty
entries.summary: IsEmpty reports whether s is "".

entries.name: Str.IsNotBlank
entries.summary: IsNotBlank reports whether s has a non-whitespace character.

entries.name: Str.IsNotEmpty
entries.summary: IsNotEmpty reports whether s is not "".

entries.name: Str.Join
entries.summary: Join joins parts with s as the separator.

entries.name: Str.LastIndex
entries.summary: LastIndex returns the rune offset of the last occurrence of substr, or -1.

entries.name: Str.Left
entries.summary: Left returns the leftmost n runes.

entries.name: Str.Len
entries.summary: Len returns the number of runes in the string.

entries.name: Str.Lower
entries.summary: Lower returns s in lowercase.

entries.name: Str.Matches
entries.summary: Matches reports whether the string contains a match of the regular expression pattern.

entries.name: Str.PadLeft
entries.signature: func (s Str) PadLeft(width int, fill ...string) Str
entries.summary: PadLeft pads the string on the left to width runes, filling with the first rune of fill (a space by default).

entries.name: Str.PadRight
entries.signature: func (s Str) PadRight(width int, fill ...string) Str
entries.summary: PadRight pads the string on the right to width runes, filling with the first rune of fill (a space by default).

entries.name: Str.RegexReplace
entries.signature: func (s Str) RegexReplace(pattern, replacement string) (Str, error)
entries.summary: RegexReplace replaces every match of pattern, or returns the compile error for an invalid pattern.

entries.name: Str.RemoveWhitespace
entries.summary: RemoveWhitespace removes every whitespace rune.

entries.name: Str.Repeat
entries.summary: Repeat repeats the string n times.

entries.name: Str.Replace
entries.signature: func (s Str) Replace(old, new string) Str
entries.summary: Replace replaces every occurrence of old with new.

entries.name: Str.ReplaceN
entries.signature: func (s Str) ReplaceN(old, new string, n int) Str
entries.summary: ReplaceN replaces the first n occurrences of old with new.

entries.name: Str.Reverse
entries.summary: Reverse reverses s rune by rune.

entries.name: Str.Right
entries.summary: Right returns the rightmost n runes.

entries.name: Str.Slice
entries.signature: func (s Str) Slice(start, end int) Str
entries.summary: Slice returns the runes from start up to end.

entries.name: Str.Split
entries.summary: Split splits s around each sep (see strings.Split).

entries.name: Str.SplitLines
entries.summary: SplitLines splits s at each "\n".

entries.name: Str.SplitN
entries.signature: func (s Str) SplitN(sep string, n int) []string
entries.summary: SplitN splits s around sep into at most n parts (see strings.SplitN).

entries.name: Str.SplitWhitespace
entries.summary: SplitWhitespace splits s around runs of whitespace (see strings.Fields).

entries.name: Str.StartsWith
entries.summary: StartsWith reports whether s begins with prefix.

entries.name: Str.String
entries.summary: String returns s as a plain string.

entries.name: Str.Title
entries.summary: Title uppercases the first letter of each word.

entries.name: Str.ToBool
entries.summary: ToBool reports whether the trimmed s is "true", "1", "yes", or "on", ignoring case.

entries.name: Str.ToFloat
entries.summary: ToFloat parses the string as a float64.

entries.name: Str.ToFloatOr
entries.summary: ToFloatOr parses the string as a float64, returning defaultValue when it does not parse.

entries.name: Str.ToInt
entries.summary: ToInt parses the string as a base-10 int.

entries.name: Str.ToIntOr
entries.summary: ToIntOr parses the string as a base-10 int, returning defaultValue when it does not parse.

entries.name: Str.Trim
entries.summary: Trim removes leading and trailing whitespace.

entries.name: Str.TrimLeft
entries.summary: TrimLeft removes leading whitespace.

entries.name: Str.TrimPrefix
entries.summary: TrimPrefix removes prefix from the start of s if it is there.

entries.name: Str.TrimRight
entries.summary: TrimRight removes trailing whitespace.

entries.name: Str.TrimSuffix
entries.summary: TrimSuffix removes suffix from the end of s if it is there.

entries.name: Str.Upper
entries.summary: Upper returns s in uppercase.

entries.name: Template
entries.signature: func Template(template string, vars map[string]string) string
entries.summary: Template replaces each {{key}} in template with vars[key].

entries.name: Truncate
entries.signature: func Truncate(s string, maxLen int, suffix ...string) string
entries.summary: Truncate shortens s to at most maxLen runes, ending in suffix ("..." by default) when it cuts.

entries.name: WordCount
entries.summary: WordCount returns the number of whitespace-separated words in s.

entries.name: Words
entries.summary: Words splits s around runs of whitespace.

entries.name: FlatMap
entries.signature: func FlatMap[T, U any](slice Slice[T], fn func(T) Slice[U]) Slice[U]
entries.summary: FlatMap calls fn on each element and concatenates the results.

entries.name: Flatten
entries.summary: Flatten concatenates slices into one new slice.

entries.name: FromSlice
entries.summary: FromSlice converts slice to a Slice.

entries.name: GroupBy
entries.signature: func GroupBy[T any, K comparable](slice Slice[T], keyFn func(T) K) map[K]Slice[T]
entries.summary: GroupBy returns the elements grouped by keyFn, each group in its original order.

entries.name: Keys
entries.signature: func Keys[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V) Slice[K]
entries.summary: Keys returns the keys of m in no particular order.

entries.name: Map
entries.signature: func Map[T, U any](slice Slice[T], fn func(T) U) Slice[U]
entries.summary: Map returns a new slice holding fn applied to each element.

entries.name: MapWithIndex
entries.signature: func MapWithIndex[T, U any](slice Slice[T], fn func(int, T) U) Slice[U]
entries.summary: MapWithIndex is Map with each element's index passed to fn.

entries.name: MaxBy
entries.signature: func MaxBy[T any](slice Slice[T], less func(T, T) bool) (T, bool)
entries.summary: MaxBy returns the largest element by less and true, or the zero value and false when slice is empty.

entries.name: MinBy
entries.signature: func MinBy[T any](slice Slice[T], less func(T, T) bool) (T, bool)
entries.summary: MinBy returns the smallest element by less and true, or the zero value and false when slice is empty.

entries.name: NewSlice
entries.summary: NewSlice returns a Slice of items.

entries.name: Pair
entries.summary: Pair is one element of a Zip result.

entries.name: Range
entries.summary: Range returns the integers from start up to but not including end.

entries.name: RangeStep
entries.signature: func RangeStep(start, end, step int) Slice[int]
entries.summary: RangeStep returns start, start+step, and so on, stopping before end.

entries.name: Reduce
entries.signature: func Reduce[T, U any](slice Slice[T], fn func(U, T) U, initial U) U
entries.summary: Reduce folds the slice into one value, starting from initial and calling fn(accumulator, element) for each element in order.

entries.name: ReduceWithIndex
entries.signature: func ReduceWithIndex[T, U any](slice Slice[T], fn func(U, int, T) U, initial U) U
entries.summary: ReduceWithIndex is Reduce with each element's index passed to fn.

entries.name: Repeat
entries.signature: func Repeat[T any](value T, n int) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Repeat creates a slice with value repeated n times.

entries.name: Slice
entries.summary: Slice is a slice with chainable query and transform methods.

entries.name: Slice.Append
entries.summary: Append returns s with items added, using the built-in append: when s has spare capacity the result shares its backing array.

entries.name: Slice.Chunk
entries.summary: Chunk splits s into consecutive pieces of size elements; the last piece may be shorter.

entries.name: Slice.Contains
entries.summary: Contains reports whether an element equals value.

entries.name: Slice.ContainsAll
entries.summary: ContainsAll reports whether s contains every one of values.

entries.name: Slice.ContainsAny
entries.summary: ContainsAny reports whether s contains at least one of values.

entries.name: Slice.Count
entries.summary: Count returns the number of elements equal to value.

entries.name: Slice.CountIf
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) CountIf(predicate func(T) bool) int
entries.summary: CountIf returns the number of elements for which predicate is true.

entries.name: Slice.Difference
entries.summary: Difference returns the elements of s that are not in other, in s's order.

entries.name: Slice.Every
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Every(predicate func(T) bool) bool
entries.summary: Every reports whether predicate is true for every element.

entries.name: Slice.Filter
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Filter(predicate func(T) bool) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Filter returns a new slice of the elements for which predicate is true.

entries.name: Slice.FilterWithIndex
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) FilterWithIndex(predicate func(int, T) bool) Slice[T]
entries.summary: FilterWithIndex is Filter with each element's index passed to predicate.

entries.name: Slice.Find
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Find(predicate func(T) bool) (T, bool)
entries.summary: Find returns the first element for which predicate is true and true, or the zero value and false.

entries.name: Slice.FindIndex
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) FindIndex(predicate func(T) bool) int
entries.summary: FindIndex returns the index of the first element for which predicate is true, or -1.

entries.name: Slice.First
entries.summary: First returns the first element and true, or the zero value and false when s is empty.

entries.name: Slice.ForEach
entries.summary: ForEach calls fn with each element in order.

entries.name: Slice.ForEachWithIndex
entries.summary: ForEachWithIndex calls fn with each index and element in order.

entries.name: Slice.Get
entries.summary: Get returns the element at index and true, or the zero value and false when index is out of range.

entries.name: Slice.GetOr
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) GetOr(index int, defaultValue T) T
entries.summary: GetOr returns the element at index, or defaultValue when index is out of range.

entries.name: Slice.Index
entries.summary: Index returns the index of the first element equal to value, or -1.

entries.name: Slice.Insert
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Insert(index int, items ...T) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Insert returns a new slice with items placed before index.

entries.name: Slice.Intersect
entries.summary: Intersect returns the elements of s that are also in other, without duplicates, in s's order.

entries.name: Slice.IsEmpty
entries.summary: IsEmpty reports whether s has no elements.

entries.name: Slice.IsNotEmpty
entries.summary: IsNotEmpty reports whether s has at least one element.

entries.name: Slice.Last
entries.summary: Last returns the last element and true, or the zero value and false when s is empty.

entries.name: Slice.LastIndex
entries.summary: LastIndex returns the index of the last element equal to value, or -1.

entries.name: Slice.Len
entries.summary: Len returns the number of elements.

entries.name: Slice.None
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) None(predicate func(T) bool) bool
entries.summary: None reports whether predicate is false for every element.

entries.name: Slice.OrEmpty
entries.summary: OrEmpty returns a non-nil slice so JSON encodes an empty collection as [].

entries.name: Slice.Partition
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Partition(predicate func(T) bool) (Slice[T], Slice[T])
entries.summary: Partition returns the elements for which predicate is true, then the rest, each in original order.

entries.name: Slice.Prepend
entries.summary: Prepend returns a new slice with items followed by the elements of s.

entries.name: Slice.Remove
entries.summary: Remove returns a new slice without the element at index.

entries.name: Slice.RemoveAll
entries.summary: RemoveAll returns a new slice without any element equal to value.

entries.name: Slice.RemoveValue
entries.summary: RemoveValue returns a new slice without the first element equal to value, or s itself when there is none.

entries.name: Slice.Reverse
entries.summary: Reverse returns a reversed copy of s.

entries.name: Slice.Skip
entries.summary: Skip returns s without its first n elements.

entries.name: Slice.SkipLast
entries.summary: SkipLast returns s without its last n elements.

entries.name: Slice.Slice
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Slice(start, end int) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Slice returns the elements from start up to end.

entries.name: Slice.Some
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Some(predicate func(T) bool) bool
entries.summary: Some reports whether predicate is true for at least one element.

entries.name: Slice.Sort
entries.signature: func (s Slice[T]) Sort(less func(T, T) bool) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Sort returns a sorted copy of s, ordered by less.

entries.name: Slice.Take
entries.summary: Take returns the first n elements, or all of s when it is shorter.

entries.name: Slice.TakeLast
entries.summary: TakeLast returns the last n elements, or all of s when it is shorter.

entries.name: Slice.ToSlice
entries.summary: ToSlice returns s as a plain slice, sharing its backing array.

entries.name: Slice.Union
entries.summary: Union returns the elements of s followed by those of other, without duplicates (see Unique).

entries.name: Slice.Unique
entries.summary: Unique returns the first occurrence of each element, preserving order.

entries.name: Times
entries.signature: func Times[T any](n int, fn func(int) T) Slice[T]
entries.summary: Times calls fn with 0..n-1 and collects the results.

entries.name: ToMap
entries.signature: func ToMap[T any, K comparable](slice Slice[T], keyFn func(T) K) map[K]T
entries.summary: ToMap returns a map from keyFn(element) to element.

entries.name: ToMapValue
entries.signature: func ToMapValue[T any, K comparable, V any](slice Slice[T], keyFn func(T) K, valueFn func(T) V) map[K]V
entries.summary: ToMapValue returns a map from keyFn(element) to valueFn(element).

entries.name: Values
entries.signature: func Values[K comparable, V any](m map[K]V) Slice[V]
entries.summary: Values returns the values of m in no particular order.

entries.name: Zip
entries.signature: func Zip[T, U any](slice1 Slice[T], slice2 Slice[U]) Slice[Pair[T, U]]
entries.summary: Zip pairs elements at the same index.

entries.name: Delete
entries.summary: Delete sends a DELETE request with a new default HTTPClient.

entries.name: FetchJSON
entries.summary: FetchJSON GETs url and parses the body as a JSON object.

entries.name: FetchJSONOr
entries.summary: FetchJSONOr is FetchJSON, returning an empty object on any error (request, body read, or decode).

entries.name: FetchText
entries.summary: FetchText GETs url and returns the body as a string.

entries.name: FetchTextOr
entries.summary: FetchTextOr is FetchText, returning defaultValue on any error.

entries.name: FromJSON
entries.summary: FromJSON parses a JSON object.

entries.name: FromJSONOr
entries.summary: FromJSONOr parses a JSON object, or returns an empty one when jsonStr is not a valid object.

entries.name: Get
entries.summary: Get sends a GET request with a new default HTTPClient.

entries.name: HTTPClient

entries.name: JSON.GetBoolOr

entries.summary: GetBoolOr returns the bool at key, or defaultValue when it is missing or not a bool.

entries.name: JSON.GetFloatOr
entries.signature: func (j JSON) GetFloatOr(key string, defaultValue float64) float64

entries.name: JSON.GetStringOr

entries.name: JSON.Has

entries.name: JSON.Keys

entries.name: JSON.Merge

entries.name: JSON.Set
entries.signature: func (j JSON) Set(key string, value any) JSON
entries.summary: Set stores value at key and returns j, allocating a map when j is nil.

entries.name: JSON.ToPrettyString

entries.name: JSON.ToString

entries.name: JSON.Values

entries.name: NewJSON

entries.summary: ParseJSONOr decodes jsonStr into a new T, or returns defaultValue when decoding fails.

entries.name: PostForm

entries.summary: PostForm sends data as a form POST with a new default HTTPClient.

entries.name: Put

entries.summary: Put sends body as a JSON PUT with a new default HTTPClient.

entries.name: QueryParams
entries.summary: QueryParams builds a URL query string.

entries.name: QueryParams.Add
entries.summary: Add adds value to key, keeping earlier values.

entries.name: QueryParams.Set
entries.summary: Set sets key to value, replacing earlier values.

entries.name: QueryParams.SetBool
entries.summary: SetBool sets key to "true" or "false".

entries.name: QueryParams.SetIf
entries.signature: func (qp *QueryParams) SetIf(condition bool, key, value string) *QueryParams
entries.summary: SetIf sets key to value when condition is true.

entries.name: QueryParams.SetIfNotEmpty
entries.summary: SetIfNotEmpty sets key to value when value is not "".

entries.name: QueryParams.SetInt
entries.summary: SetInt sets key to the decimal form of value.

entries.name: QueryParams.String
entries.summary: String returns the encoded query, sorted by key, without a leading "?".

entries.name: QueryParams.URL
entries.summary: URL appends the query to baseURL with "?", or with "&" when baseURL already has a query.

entries.name: QueryParams.Values
entries.summary: Values returns the underlying url.Values, not a copy.

entries.name: ToJSON
entries.summary: ToJSON encodes v as compact JSON, or "{}" when encoding fails.

entries.name: ToPrettyJSON
entries.summary: ToPrettyJSON encodes v as JSON indented by two spaces, or "{}" when encoding fails.

entries.name: Catch
entries.signature: func Catch(fn func() error, handler func(error))
entries.summary: Catch calls fn through Try and passes any error, including a recovered panic, to handler.

entries.name: CatchValue
entries.signature: func CatchValue[T any](fn func() (T, error), handler func(error) T) T
entries.summary: CatchValue calls fn through TryValue and returns its value.

entries.name: Chain
entries.summary: Chain runs a sequence of steps and stops at the first error, which it keeps.

entries.name: Chain.Do
entries.summary: Do calls fn unless an earlier step failed.

entries.name: Chain.DoValue
entries.summary: DoValue is the same as Do.

entries.name: Chain.Error
entries.summary: Error returns the first error a step returned, or nil if every step succeeded.

entries.name: Chain.Result
entries.summary: Result is the same as Error.

entries.name: Chain.Success
entries.summary: Success reports whether every step so far succeeded.

entries.name: Default
entries.signature: func Default[T any](value T, err error, defaultValue T) T
entries.summary: Default returns value if err is nil, otherwise defaultValue.

entries.name: ErrorHandler
entries.summary: ErrorHandler controls what Must does with a non-nil error: log it with the caller's file and line, then panic.

entries.name: ErrorHandler.Must
entries.summary: Must panics with err if err is not nil.

entries.name: ErrorHandler.Silent
entries.summary: Silent makes Must panic without logging, for code that reports the panic at a higher level.

entries.name: ErrorHandler.WithLogger
entries.summary: WithLogger sets the printf-style function Must logs through.

entries.name: ErrorInfo
entries.summary: ErrorInfo pairs an error with the file, line, and function where GetErrorInfo was called.

entries.name: ErrorInfo.String
entries.summary: String formats the error as "file:line in function: error".

entries.name: GetErrorInfo
entries.summary: GetErrorInfo records err with the caller's file, line, and function name.

entries.name: Ignore
entries.summary: Ignore discards err.

entries.name: IgnoreValue
entries.signature: func IgnoreValue[T any](value T, err error) T
entries.summary: IgnoreValue returns value and discards err.

entries.name: Must
entries.summary: Must panics with err if err is not nil, logging the caller's file and line first through the package default handler (see SetDefaultLogger and SetDefaultSilent).

entries.name: MustValue
entries.signature: func MustValue[T any](value T, err error) T
entries.summary: MustValue returns value if err is nil and otherwise panics like Must.

entries.name: NewChain

entries.name: NewErrorHandler
entries.summary: NewErrorHandler returns an ErrorHandler that logs with log.Printf before panicking.

entries.name: OrLog
entries.signature: func OrLog[T any](value T, err error) T
entries.summary: OrLog returns value if err is nil.

entries.name: OrLogDefault
entries.signature: func OrLogDefault[T any](value T, err error, defaultValue T) T
entries.summary: OrLogDefault returns value if err is nil.

entries.name: OrPanic
entries.signature: func OrPanic[T any](value T, err error) T
entries.summary: OrPanic returns value if err is nil and otherwise panics with err.

entries.name: SetDefaultSilent
entries.summary: SetDefaultSilent sets whether the package-level Must and MustValue skip logging before they panic.

entries.name: Try

entries.name: TryValue

entries.name: Safe.IsNil

entries.name: Safe.IsNotNil

entries.name: SafeSlice.Len

entries.summary: DirHelper chains operations on one directory path.

entries.summary: Create creates the directory and any missing parents.

entries.summary: Dirs returns the paths of the directory's subdirectories.

entries.summary: Error returns the error from the first failed operation, or nil.

entries.summary: Exists reports whether the path exists and is a directory.

entries.summary: Files returns the paths of the directory's non-directory entries.

entries.summary: List returns the paths of the directory's entries (see ListAll), or the stored error from an earlier step.

entries.name: DirHelper.Path
entries.summary: Path returns the directory path.

entries.summary: Remove removes the directory and everything under it.

entries.summary: Walk returns every non-directory under the directory (see WalkFiles).

entries.name: File
entries.summary: File returns a FileHelper for path.

entries.name: FileExists
entries.summary: FileExists reports whether filename can be stat'd.

entries.name: FileHelper
entries.summary: FileHelper chains operations on one file path.

entries.summary: Append appends content to the file (see AppendFile).

entries.name: FileHelper.Copy
entries.summary: Copy copies the file to dst (see CopyFile).

entries.name: FileHelper.Delete
entries.summary: Delete removes the file.

entries.name: FileHelper.Error
entries.summary: Error returns the error from the first failed operation, or nil.

entries.name: FileHelper.Exists
entries.summary: Exists reports whether the path exists (see FileExists).

entries.name: FileHelper.Move
entries.summary: Move renames the file to dst (see MoveFile).

entries.name: FileHelper.Path
entries.summary: Path returns the file path, which Move updates.

entries.summary: Read returns the file's contents, or the stored error from an earlier step.

entries.name: FileHelper.ReadOr
entries.summary: ReadOr returns the file's contents, or defaultContent when Read fails.

entries.summary: Size returns the file size in bytes, or 0 when it cannot be stat'd.

entries.summary: Write replaces the file's contents (see WriteFile).

entries.summary: Dump returns a copy of the values loaded from .env files and set with Set.

entries.summary: GetBool reports whether the value for key is "true", "1", "yes", or "on", ignoring case.

entries.name: Env.GetBoolOr

entries.summary: GetBoolOr returns defaultValue when key is unset or empty, and GetBool otherwise.

entries.summary: GetFloat parses the value for key as a float64.

entries.name: Env.GetFloatOr

entries.summary: GetFloatOr returns the value for key as a float64, or defaultValue when it is unset, empty, or not a number.

entries.name: Env.GetInt
entries.summary: GetInt parses the value for key as an int.

entries.name: Env.GetIntOr
entries.signature: func (e *Env) GetIntOr(key string, defaultValue int) int
entries.summary: GetIntOr returns the value for key as an int, or defaultValue when it is unset, empty, or not an integer.

entries.name: Env.GetOr
entries.summary: GetOr returns the value for key, or defaultValue when it is unset or empty.

entries.name: Env.GetSlice
entries.summary: GetSlice splits the value for key on commas and trims each part.

entries.name: Env.Has
entries.summary: Has reports whether any source has key, even with an empty value.

entries.name: Env.Keys
entries.summary: Keys returns the keys of All in no particular order.

entries.summary: LoadDefault loads .env, .env.local, and .env.development from the working directory, in that order, skipping any that do not exist.

entries.name: Env.LoadFile
entries.summary: LoadFile reads KEY=value lines from filename.

entries.name: Env.LoadFiles
entries.summary: LoadFiles calls LoadFile for each name in order and stops at the first error.

entries.name: Env.LoadedFiles
entries.summary: LoadedFiles returns a copy of the names of the files loaded so far, in load order.

entries.name: Env.Save
entries.summary: Save writes the current .env variables to filename, sorted by key.

entries.name: Env.Set
entries.summary: Set sets a value in code (in memory only).

entries.name: Env.SetSystem
entries.summary: SetSystem calls Set and also sets key in the process environment.

entries.name: Env.Validate
entries.summary: Validate returns an error listing every key in required that no source has.

entries.name: EnvConfig
entries.summary: EnvConfig configures Env.LoadConfig.

entries.name: GetEnv
entries.summary: GetEnv returns the package-level Env's value for key (see Env.Get).

entries.name: GetEnvBool
entries.summary: GetEnvBool reports whether the value for key is "true", "1", "yes", or "on", ignoring case.

entries.name: GetEnvBoolOr
entries.signature: func GetEnvBoolOr(key string, defaultValue bool) bool
entries.summary: GetEnvBoolOr returns defaultValue when key is unset or empty, and GetEnvBool otherwise.

entries.name: GetEnvInt
entries.summary: GetEnvInt parses the value for key as an int.

entries.name: GetEnvIntOr
entries.signature: func GetEnvIntOr(key string, defaultValue int) int
entries.summary: GetEnvIntOr returns the value for key as an int, or defaultValue when it is unset, empty, or not an integer.

entries.name: GetEnvOr
entries.summary: GetEnvOr returns the value for key, or defaultValue when it is unset or empty.

entries.name: HasEnv
entries.summary: HasEnv reports whether any source has key, even with an empty value.

entries.name: LoadEnv
entries.summary: LoadEnv loads the named .env files into the package-level Env, or the LoadDefault files when no names are given.

entries.name: NewEnv
entries.summary: NewEnv returns an empty Env.

entries.name: RequireEnv
entries.summary: RequireEnv returns an error listing every key that no source has.

entries.name: SetEnv
entries.summary: SetEnv sets key on the package-level Env and in the process environment.

entries.summary: ConfigureLogger applies config to the logger behind the package-level functions.

entries.name: Debug
entries.summary: Debug logs a formatted message at DEBUG level through the default logger.

entries.name: Error
entries.summary: Error logs a formatted message at ERROR level through the default logger.

entries.name: Fatal
entries.summary: Fatal logs a formatted message at FATAL level through the default logger, then exits the process with status 1.

entries.name: Info
entries.summary: Info logs a formatted message at INFO level through the default logger.

entries.name: Log
entries.summary: Log logs its arguments, joined as fmt.Sprint does, at DEBUG level.

entries.name: LogError
entries.summary: LogError logs err at ERROR level as "Error (context...): err".

entries.name: LogErrorf
entries.signature: func LogErrorf(err error, format string, args ...any)
entries.summary: LogErrorf logs err at ERROR level with a formatted context, as "Error (context): err".

entries.name: LogLevel
entries.summary: LogLevel is a Logger severity.

entries.name: LogLevel.Color
entries.summary: Color returns the ANSI escape that colors the level name, or the reset code for an unknown level.

entries.name: LogLevel.String
entries.summary: String returns the level name, such as "WARN", or "UNKNOWN".

entries.name: Logf
entries.summary: Logf logs a formatted message at DEBUG level.

entries.name: Logger
entries.summary: Logger writes leveled, printf-style log lines of the form "2006-01-02 15:04:05 [LEVEL] [prefix] file:line message".

entries.name: Logger.Debug
entries.summary: Debug logs a formatted message at DEBUG level.

entries.name: Logger.Error
entries.summary: Error logs a formatted message at ERROR level.

entries.name: Logger.Fatal
entries.summary: Fatal logs a formatted message at FATAL level, then exits the process with status 1.

entries.name: Logger.Info
entries.summary: Info logs a formatted message at INFO level.

entries.name: Logger.SetColored
entries.summary: SetColored turns ANSI colors on the level name on or off.

entries.name: Logger.SetLevel
entries.summary: SetLevel sets the lowest level the logger writes.

entries.name: Logger.SetOutput
entries.summary: SetOutput sets the writer log lines go to.

entries.name: Logger.SetPrefix
entries.summary: SetPrefix sets text written in brackets after the level on every line.

entries.name: Logger.SetShowCaller
entries.summary: SetShowCaller turns the caller's file:line on or off.

entries.name: Logger.Warn
entries.summary: Warn logs a formatted message at WARN level.

entries.name: Logger.WithField
entries.summary: WithField returns a copy of the logger whose prefix gains "key=value".

entries.name: Logger.WithFields
entries.summary: WithFields returns a copy of the logger whose prefix gains "key=value" for each field, sorted by key.

entries.name: LoggerConfig
entries.summary: LoggerConfig holds the settings ConfigureLogger applies.

entries.name: NewLogger
entries.summary: NewLogger returns a Logger that writes INFO and above to os.Stdout with colored level names and no caller information.

entries.name: Print
entries.summary: Print logs its arguments, joined as fmt.Sprint does, at INFO level.

entries.name: Printf
entries.summary: Printf logs a formatted message at INFO level.

entries.name: SetLogColored
entries.summary: SetLogColored turns colored level names on or off for the package-level functions.

entries.name: SetLogLevel
entries.summary: SetLogLevel sets the lowest level the package-level functions write.

entries.name: SetLogOutput
entries.summary: SetLogOutput sets the writer the package-level functions write to.

entries.name: SetLogShowCaller
entries.summary: SetLogShowCaller turns caller file:line on or off for the package-level functions.

entries.name: SetupDevelopmentLogging
entries.summary: SetupDevelopmentLogging makes the package-level functions write DEBUG and above to stdout, colored, with caller information.

entries.name: SetupProductionLogging
entries.summary: SetupProductionLogging makes the package-level functions write INFO and above to stdout, uncolored, without caller information.

entries.name: SetupTestLogging
entries.summary: SetupTestLogging discards all package-level log output.

entries.name: Warn
entries.summary: Warn logs a formatted message at WARN level through the default logger.

entries.name: MemoryStats
entries.summary: MemoryStats is a snapshot of runtime memory figures, in megabytes, plus the GC count and goroutine count.

entries.name: NewProfiler
entries.summary: NewProfiler returns an enabled Profiler with no data.

entries.name: PathStats
entries.summary: PathStats summarizes the recorded requests for one path.

entries.name: ProfileStats
entries.summary: ProfileStats is the snapshot GetStats returns.

entries.name: Profiler
entries.summary: Profiler records request timings through its Middleware and named timings through StartTimer and TimeOperation.

entries.name: Profiler.Disable
entries.summary: Disable turns recording off and returns p.

entries.name: Profiler.Enable
entries.summary: Enable turns recording on and returns p.

entries.name: Profiler.GetRequestsByPath
entries.summary: GetRequestsByPath returns timing statistics for each recorded path.

entries.name: Profiler.GetStats
entries.summary: GetStats returns a snapshot of the recorded requests, the named timers with at least one completed run, and current memory figures.

entries.name: Profiler.GetTopSlowRequests
entries.summary: GetTopSlowRequests returns up to n recorded requests, slowest first.

entries.name: Profiler.IsEnabled
entries.summary: IsEnabled reports whether the profiler is recording.

entries.name: Profiler.Middleware
entries.summary: Middleware returns middleware that records each request's method, path, status, duration, and bytes allocated, for app.Use.

entries.name: Profiler.PrintStats
entries.summary: PrintStats writes a readable summary of GetStats to stdout.

entries.name: Profiler.Reset
entries.summary: Reset discards every recorded request and timer and restarts the uptime clock.

entries.name: Profiler.StartTimer
entries.summary: StartTimer starts a new run of the named timer and returns it.

entries.name: Profiler.StatsHandler
entries.summary: StatsHandler returns an http.Handler that serves GetStats as JSON.

entries.name: Profiler.StopTimer
entries.summary: StopTimer stops the most recently started run of the named timer that is still running and returns its duration, or 0 when none is running.

entries.name: Profiler.TimeOperation
entries.signature: func (p *Profiler) TimeOperation(name string, fn func()) (duration time.Duration)
entries.summary: TimeOperation calls fn, records the run under name, and returns its duration.

entries.name: Profiler.TimeOperationWithResult
entries.signature: func (p *Profiler) TimeOperationWithResult(name string, fn func() any) (result any, duration time.Duration)
entries.summary: TimeOperationWithResult is TimeOperation for a function that returns a value; it returns that value and the duration.

entries.name: RequestProfile
entries.summary: RequestProfile is one request the Middleware recorded.

entries.name: Timer
entries.summary: Timer is one run of a named timer, returned by StartTimer.

entries.name: Timer.Stop
entries.summary: Stop ends this run, records it in the timer's statistics, and returns its duration.

entries.name: TimerStats
entries.summary: TimerStats summarizes the completed runs of one named timer.

entries.name: AirBuildConfig
entries.summary: AirBuildConfig is the [build] section of an Air configuration.

entries.name: AirConfig
entries.summary: AirConfig is an Air live-reload configuration.

entries.name: AirConfig.SaveAirConfig
entries.summary: SaveAirConfig writes ToTOML to filename, or to .air.toml when filename is empty.

entries.name: AirConfig.ToTOML
entries.summary: ToTOML renders the configuration as the contents of an .air.toml file, with the [build], [color], log, and [misc] sections.

entries.name: AirHelper
entries.summary: AirHelper sets up Air for the project in one directory.

entries.name: AirHelper.AddBuildArgs
entries.summary: AddBuildArgs adds arguments Air passes to the binary when it runs it.

entries.name: AirHelper.AddExcludeDir
entries.summary: AddExcludeDir adds directories Air does not watch.

entries.name: AirHelper.AddWatchExt
entries.summary: AddWatchExt adds file extensions, without dots, that trigger a rebuild.

entries.name: AirHelper.CreateDevScript
entries.summary: CreateDevScript writes an executable dev.sh to the project root.

entries.name: AirHelper.GetInstallInstructions
entries.summary: GetInstallInstructions returns text describing the ways to install Air.

entries.name: AirHelper.InitAir
entries.summary: InitAir creates tmp/ and writes .air.toml in the project root.

entries.name: AirHelper.IsAirInstalled
entries.summary: IsAirInstalled reports whether an air binary exists in /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin, $GOPATH/bin, or $HOME/go/bin.

entries.name: AirHelper.SetBinPath
entries.summary: SetBinPath sets the path of the binary Air runs after a build.

entries.name: AirHelper.SetBuildCmd
entries.summary: SetBuildCmd sets the command Air runs to build the binary.

entries.name: AirHelper.UpdateConfig
entries.summary: UpdateConfig calls modifier with the configuration so it can change any field.

entries.name: AirInstallHelp
entries.summary: AirInstallHelp returns text describing the ways to install Air.

entries.name: AirLogConfig
entries.summary: AirLogConfig is the log section of an Air configuration.

entries.name: AirMiscConfig
entries.summary: AirMiscConfig is the [misc] section of an Air configuration.

entries.name: AirWatchConfig
entries.summary: AirWatchConfig holds the watch lists kept in AirConfig.Watch.

entries.name: CreateHyperChiAirConfig
entries.summary: CreateHyperChiAirConfig writes HyperChiAirConfig to filename, or to .air.toml when filename is empty.

entries.name: DefaultAirConfig
entries.summary: DefaultAirConfig returns an Air configuration that builds ./tmp/main from the current directory and watches Go, template, HTML, JS, and CSS files.

entries.name: HyperChiAirConfig
entries.summary: HyperChiAirConfig returns DefaultAirConfig extended for a HyperChi project: it also watches .md, .env, .gotmpl, and .gohtml files and skips the static, uploads, logs, storage, and cache directories.

entries.name: InitAirConfig
entries.summary: InitAirConfig runs AirHelper.InitAir in the current directory.

entries.name: IsAirAvailable
entries.summary: IsAirAvailable reports whether Air is installed (see AirHelper.IsAirInstalled).

entries.name: NewAirHelper
entries.summary: NewAirHelper returns an AirHelper for projectRoot, or for the current directory when projectRoot is empty.

entries.name: CreateDeploymentFiles
entries.summary: CreateDeploymentFiles writes every deployment file for appName into projectRoot: Dockerfile, compose file, production .env, build and deploy scripts, nginx and systemd configs, and a health check.

entries.name: DeploymentConfig
entries.summary: DeploymentConfig describes how an app is deployed.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper
entries.summary: DeploymentHelper writes deployment files (Dockerfile, compose file, scripts, server configs) for one project directory and app name.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateBuildScript
entries.summary: CreateBuildScript writes an executable build.sh that cross-compiles release archives into dist/ and builds a Docker image.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateDeployScript
entries.summary: CreateDeployScript writes an executable deploy.sh.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateDeploymentFiles
entries.summary: CreateDeploymentFiles writes the Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, systemd unit, deploy.sh, and nginx.conf.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateDockerCompose
entries.summary: CreateDockerCompose writes docker-compose.yml with the app service on port 8080, a data volume, and an nginx service in front of it.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateDockerfile
entries.summary: CreateDockerfile writes a multi-stage Dockerfile, and a .dockerignore when the project has none.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateHealthCheck
entries.summary: CreateHealthCheck writes health.go, standard-library health, readiness, and liveness handlers for package main.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateNginxConfig
entries.summary: CreateNginxConfig writes nginx.conf, a reverse proxy in front of the app on port 8080.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateProductionEnv
entries.summary: CreateProductionEnv writes a .env.production template with mode 0600.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.CreateSystemdService
entries.summary: CreateSystemdService writes <appName>.service, a systemd unit that runs the app.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.DefaultDeploymentConfig
entries.summary: DefaultDeploymentConfig returns a production config for linux/amd64 on port 8080 with a /health check.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.GetBuildInfo
entries.summary: GetBuildInfo returns the Go version, OS, architecture, current UTC time, app name, and a Unix-time deployment ID as strings.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.GetProductionConfig
entries.summary: GetProductionConfig returns recommended production settings as a ProductionConfig.

entries.name: DeploymentHelper.SwitchToProduction
entries.summary: SwitchToProduction loads .env.production from the project root and returns an error when APP_NAME, ENVIRONMENT, JWT_SECRET, or SESSION_SECRET is missing.

entries.name: NewDeploymentHelper
entries.summary: NewDeploymentHelper returns a DeploymentHelper for projectRoot (default ".") and appName (default "hyperchi-app").

entries.name: ProductionConfig
entries.summary: ProductionConfig is a set of recommended production settings returned by GetProductionConfig.

entries.name: SwitchEnvironment
entries.summary: SwitchEnvironment copies .env.<env> over .env in the working directory.
